Player vs dealer blackjack in vanilla JS (casino / blackjack / cards
modules) with session save over AJAX to a sample API. The server is
gone. The dealer runs in the host browser. Invite is extra seats: each
person has a hand; the host deals. Cards are drawn
in CSS — the PNG deck and the Bootstrap/jQuery/CDN stack stay behind.
